senses.gloss: (sub. שוקים) one having high and arched shoulders, hump-backed.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:8:2">Y. Keth. VII, end, 31ᵈ</cite> <he>עובדא … בכ׳</he> (not <he>בכופיח</he>) a case (petition for divorce) came before R. J. against a husband who had become hump-backed (after marriage), and he forced him (to a divorce).

senses.gloss: (v. גִּבֵּחַ, גְּבִיחַ) an extremely tall and unshapely person.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">Bekh. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 45b:7">45ᵇ</cite>) <he>כ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קפ׳</he>), v. <cite ref="C00067"><he>גִּבֵּחַ</he></cite>.
